The '''Ductavis Era''' was an era of time in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] from [[10,966 BBY]] to [[9000 BBY]]. It was considered a time of rebuilding after the crusades of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Contispex I/Legends|Contispex I]] during the [[Pius Dea Era]].

==Timeline of this period==
*10,966 BBY
**[[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Biel Ductavis]] assumes the position of Supreme Chancellor; his ascension heralds the end of the Pius Dea era and the start of the [[Ductavis Era]].<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[10,000 BBY]]
**The historian [[Vicendi]] compiles a list of the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]] for his [[Arturum Galactinum]], a work commissioned for the Republic's anniversary.<ref name="Atlas" />
**[[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] enters the Galactic Republic. {{Circa}}<ref name="Atlas" />
**The [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] species begin to record their history. {{Circa}}<ref name="Essential Alien">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>
**[[Ammuud/Legends|Ammuud]] is settled as a religious retreat by colonists from [[Thokos]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Atlas" />
**The [[Kumauri Empire]] comes into [[Battle between the Kumauri Empire and the Republic|conflict]] with the Republic, deploying planet-busting battleships with mass drivers, though they are defeated. {{Circa}}<ref name="Warfare" />
**The planet [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]] and its [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] inhabitants are discovered by Corellian traders. {{Circa}}<ref name="Coruscant and Core">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
**[[Madilon]] is discovered and becomes a principle component in [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] manufacturing. {{Circa}}<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref>
*[[9757 BBY]]
**The [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit|Republic rocket-jumpers]] participate in the [[Second Herglic Feud]].<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
*[[9400s BBY]]
**Planetary shielding begins to see widespread use across the galaxy.<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[9349 BBY]]
**The Korden family officially becomes the noble House Korden.<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue" />
*[[9200s BBY]]
**Planetary turbolasers are first commonly deployed around this time.<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[9000 BBY]]
**The [[Rianitus Period]] begins.<ref name="Atlas" />
